reviews.text: Sage, Jesus and the entire crew has this down to a science. I contracted out each step of my pool build and working with Atlantis (Sage) was by far the most comfortable experience knowing how competent they were. Always showed up early, worked quickly, and had such a quality result at the end. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Colt/Delaney Bosson

reviews.text: Excellent service and products. Blue surf with shells and glass beads.  Pool prep needed more than expected work and they did not request any more money. What they said they would do they did. Did not try to cut back on products. Pricing was very fair. They even followed up making sure that the chemicals were being done correctly. This company stands behind their product and workmanship.  Tom Wilcox Carrollon Tx
reviews.author: Tommy Wilcox

reviews.text: This company was top shelf! They showed up on time and cleaned up after every project! I’ve had pools for 32 years and never had one this beautiful! I highly recommend Atlantis Pool! My pebble-tec pool is gorgeous!
reviews.author: Tom Lowrey

reviews.text: Due to shady workmanship that plagues the pool industries I decide to build my own pool to make sure it was done right. When it came down to the plastering I contacted every advertise plastering contractor in our area and Atlantis was the only guys that showed up. Not only did they return my call immediately they had my estimate within 24 hours of that call which was incredible due to the high volume of pools being built during the Covid apocalypse. Since I was a homeowner building my first pool Atlantis was more that helpful explaining  the procedure and extremely patient answering all my dumb question. The Crew they have was well trained and paid close attention to detail. After they completed plastering the pool they thoroughly cleaned up the mess and asked me if there was anything that needed attention before they left. The representative for Atlantis had followed up on several occasions to make sure there were no problems and would still answer my dumb question several months later. The plaster has been in our pool for 18 Months now and it still looks as good as the day they completed it. My wife tells me that I am the most picky man on the planet and I am never happy but she is wrong because I am happy with these guys.
reviews.author: Stasi Sanders

reviews.text: Wonderful experience with Atlantas Pool Plaster! Top Notch. Excellent crews and workers. Very conscientious. Sage Watson is trustworthy. Totally a person of his word all the way through the process from initial meeting to finished product. Punctual, honest, informative. We have a beautiful pool. The Pebble Brilliance Vivid  Shores is gorgeous.
reviews.author: Chery Lofton

reviews.text: One of your service vehicles operating in New Braunfels is giving your company a bad rep. While heading into town on State HWY 46W your service driver found it appropriate to try and cut me off and then flip me off passing me on the shoulder of an intersection. Completely unacceptable.
reviews.author: Taylor Criss

reviews.text: Really enjoyed working with Atlantis and Sage Watson. Great communication, professionalism and extremely helpful throughout. 100% recommend!
reviews.author: Benjamin Russell

reviews.text: Atlantis Plastering is the best!! Sage, Jesus and their entire plaster crew were fantastic to work with from the initial quote, to prep, plaster and completion. They went above and beyond and we can’t thank them enough! Sage and his team have incredible customer service, were always on time, great communicators, cleaned up after the job was complete and were always kind and respectful. If anyone is looking for a superior pebble tech finish for a new build or remodel, Atlantis pools and plastering is the only company you should call! Thank you!!
reviews.author: Erika Klemetsen

data.summary: The available reviews for Atlantis Pool Plastering appear largely authentic, with detailed, specific praise from customers. The single negative review is about driver behavior, not work quality. The low total review count (23 on Google, 8 sampled) and high proportion of 5-star reviews warrant caution, but the content suggests a competent, well-regarded contractor. No major red flags for fake reviews or systematic service failures are present.
